title: Real-time fall detection based on vision for low-power edge platforms
abstract: arXiv:2607.12909v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Falling detection is vital for elderly care and intelligent surveillance; however, prevailing vision-based approaches predominantly frame it as static pose classification or discrete temporal pattern matching, fundamentally overlooking the instability dynamics of the human support system. This paper proposes a physics-informed falling detection framework that recasts falling as a stability-loss event in a coupled dynamical system. We introduce a novel dual-LTC architecture comprising a Center-of-Mass (CoM) subsystem and a Base-of-Support (BoS) subsystem, both instantiated as Liquid Time-Constant (LTC) neural networks to continuously model inertial trajectory evolution and ground-contact adjustment through adaptive time constants, Physical interpretability of falling motion. A learnable coupling module emulates physical interaction between the two subsystems, while a Stability Manifold classifier operates in the joint latent spa

translated_title: 基于视觉的低功耗边缘平台实时跌倒检测
translated_abstract: 跌倒检测对老年人护理和智能监控至关重要；然而，现有的基于视觉的方法主要将其框定为静态姿态分类或离散时间模式匹配，从根本上忽视了人体支撑系统的不稳定动力学特性。本文提出了一种基于物理信息的跌倒检测框架，将跌倒重新定义为耦合动力系统中的稳定性丧失事件。我们引入了一种新颖的双LTC（液态时间常数）架构，包含质心子系统和支持基面子系统，两者均实例化为液态时间常数（LTC）神经网络，通过自适应时间常数连续建模惯性轨迹演化与地面接触调整，实现跌倒运动的物理可解释性。一个可学习的耦合模块模拟两个子系统之间的物理交互，而稳定性流形分类器则在联合潜在空间中运行。
tldr: 该论文提出一种基于物理信息的双液态时间常数（LTC）网络架构，将跌倒建模为质心与支撑基面耦合动力系统的稳定性丧失事件，通过可学习的物理交互耦合模块与稳定性流形分类器，实现了低功耗边缘平台上的实时视觉跌倒检测。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a physics-informed dual-LTC architecture that recasts falling as a stability-loss event in a coupled dynamical system with a learnable interaction coupling module and stability manifold classifier, enabling real-time vision-based fall detection on low-power edge platforms.
